messages.content: You advise merchants on chargeback evidence. Defense-only. Concise and actionable.

A chargeback case is at 13% win probability (current decision: ACCEPT, amount Rs 19888). The merchant can still gather these documents, each with the model's win-probability lift: Consent / terms record (+19 pts -> 32%). In at most 2 sentences, tell the merchant the single highest-impact document to gather (Consent / terms record) and what it does to the decision / expected value. Defense-only, concrete, plain text.

content: Gather the **Consent/terms record**—it adds +19 percentage‑points to your win probability, raising it from 13 % to about 32 %. This boost turns the expected outcome from a likely loss to a modest chance of success, improving the economic value of fighting the Rs 19,888 chargeback.
